analysis.description: This paper introduces TopiOCQA, an open-domain conversational dataset with topic switches based on Wikipedia. The dataset contains 3,920 conversations with information-seeking questions and free-form answers, spanning an average of 13 question-answer turns and involving four topics. The work evaluates several baselines combining state-of-the-art document retrieval methods with neural reader models, indicating the dataset poses a challenging test-bed for models.

type.justification: The paper presents an empirical study by collecting a new dataset and evaluating multiple models against it, showcasing experimental results and comparisons.
type.quote: We introduce T OPI OCQA (pronounced Tapioca), an open-domain conversational dataset with topic switches based on Wikipedia. We evaluate several baselines, by combining state-of-the-art document retrieval methods with neural reader models.
